Package com.sbancuz.offscreen.api

@ParametersAreNonnullByDefault package com.sbancuz.offscreen.api
Public entry points for opening, adapting, and managing detached GUI windows.

Start with OffscreenAPI for local screens. Ordinary GuiScreen subclasses use the built-in vanilla adapter. For custom adapter behavior, implement HostUI and register its factory through UIRegistry.

For ModularUI screens that update server state, use OffscreenSimpleFactory. It manages the synchronized session for you. Session provides the lower-level lifecycle hooks for other server/framework bindings.

Window operations run on Minecraft's client thread after initialization. Unless annotated otherwise, parameters are non-null. Explicit null-friendly helpers document their no-op or empty result. No helper silently schedules arbitrary background-thread calls onto the client thread.
